def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    equity_value = 150
    equity_cost = 0.12
    debt_value = 100
    debt_cost = 0.05
    preferred_value = 50
    preferred_cost = 0.08

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_value = equity_value + debt_value + preferred_value
    weight_equity = equity_value / total_value
    weight_debt = debt_value / total_value
    weight_preferred = preferred_value / total_value

    wacc = (
        weight_equity * equity_cost
        + weight_debt * debt_cost
        + weight_preferred * preferred_cost
    )

    # Return WACC as a percentage rounded to two decimal places
    return round(wacc * 100, 2)
